scope: Bounded read-only supplemental check requested before freeze. It tests whether a hand-crafted canonical empty knowledge request can bypass the required no_change behavior and checks complete write/read/path transport limits through the existing bundle encoder and _transport_limits size guard. No production source, Vault, Git, network, operator, or human-gate mutation was performed.

documented_differences: R5 updates publication.py, markdown_source.py, catalog_collector.py, formal_source.py, cli.py and selected tests/fixtures for the command-tree fixture and current regressions; these are outside this supplemental probe's source-binding claims.

hash_replay.result: 27 of 27 candidate files match their recorded hashes

empty_durable_request_check.setup: A disposable synthetic Vault was advanced through registration and applied modern knowledge publication. A valid current basis and prospective inventory digest came from prepare_source_publication(payloads={}), whose result was state=no_change with no request path.
empty_durable_request_check.request: A separate canonical request with the same current basis/prospective digest, kind=knowledge, registration=null, and payloads=[] was manually staged under a fresh fixed batch.
empty_durable_request_check.error_message: input is not bounded strict UTF-8 JSON
empty_durable_request_check.interpretation: The request cannot reach _assemble_publication_transaction or mint receipt/head authority. The rejection is caused by the request schema's minItems=1 rule, while the public prepare path returns no_change and does not stage a request. No no-op receipt authority bypass was reproduced.

checks.evidence: payload_map enforces MAX_PAYLOADS=1022 before _transport_limits constructs receipt/head descriptors.
encode_transaction_inspect_bundle rejects writes above 1024; an allowed 1022-business request plus receipt/head reaches exactly 1024 total writes.

The existing encoder produced a 13,440,605-byte canonical bundle for 80,000 read preconditions against MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES=8,388,608. _transport_limits explicitly rejects len(bundle)>MAX_BUNDLE_BYTES after encoding, so it cannot truncate the complete read set.

transport_limit_checks.static_conclusion: No remaining transport-limit bypass was found in the reviewed path: business path count is bounded by payload_map, write count by the existing encoder/transaction contracts, and complete read-set size by the explicit _transport_limits encoded-bundle check.

limitations: This supplemental check is bound to the frozen local candidate snapshot above; exact commit, full-suite, wheel, CI, and human gates remain open.

The no-op request's user-facing message is the existing generic SOURCE_PUBLICATION_INVALID wrapper text even though the schema minItems rule is the rejection cause; this affects diagnostic precision only and did not permit authority creation.
